title: Taylor Farms recalls salsa and guacamole over salmonella risk
summary: Taylor Farms voluntarily recalled salsa and guacamole products due to salmonella risk after being notified of contaminated fresh peppers from a supplier. The recall affects multiple salsa and guacamole products distributed through the company.
content: The supplier voluntarily recalled the products, including salsas and guacamole, after being notified that Coast Citrus Distributors was recalling fresh peppers.

zh.title: 泰勒农场因沙门氏菌风险召回莎莎酱和鳄梨酱
zh.summary: 泰勒农场在得知供应商的新鲜辣椒受到污染后，自愿召回莎莎酱和鳄梨酱产品以防止沙门氏菌风险。该召回影响了通过该公司分销的多种莎莎酱和鳄梨酱产品。

title: U.S. stock futures dip as investors await inflation data, grapple with more Iran uncertainty
summary: U.S. stock-index futures remained largely stable as investors monitored Iran's renewed demands that threaten to jeopardize the Strait of Hormuz reopening deal, while awaiting critical inflation data later in the week.
content: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday, after new demands from Iran raised fresh doubts about the Strait of Hormuz reopening anytime soon and as investors await key inflation data later this week.

zh.title: 美国股指期货下跌，投资者等待通胀数据并应对伊朗不确定性
zh.summary: 美国股指期货基本保持稳定，投资者监视伊朗新提出的可能危害霍尔木兹海峡重开协议的要求，同时等待本周晚些时候公布的关键通胀数据。

title: Oil rises amid uncertainty over U.S.-Iran Strait of Hormuz deal
summary: Oil prices rose as traders assessed conflicting signals from U.S. and Iran negotiations over reopening the Strait of Hormuz, with growing concerns that a deal may not materialize soon.
content: Oil rose as traders assess mixed signals from the U.S. and Iran amid worries that a deal to open the Strait of Hormuz may not be coming anytime soon.

zh.title: 由于美国-伊朗霍尔木兹海峡协议的不确定性，油价上升
zh.summary: 由于交易员评估美国和伊朗关于重开霍尔木兹海峡谈判中的相互矛盾的信号，加上对协议可能无法很快达成的日益增长的担忧，油价上升。

title: S&P 500 futures slip as traders watch for Strait of Hormuz deal, inflation data: Live updates
summary: Following the S&P 500's best week since April and a new all-time closing high on Friday, stock futures dipped as traders focused on developments in Strait of Hormuz negotiations and upcoming inflation data.
content: The three major indexes are coming off their best weeks since April, and the S&P 500 finished Friday at an all-time closing high.

zh.title: 交易员关注霍尔木兹海峡协议和通胀数据，标普500期货下跌：实时更新
zh.summary: 在标普500指数经历4月以来最好的一周并在周五创下历史新高之后，交易员关注霍尔木兹海峡谈判最新进展和即将公布的通胀数据，期货市场出现下滑。
